fields.name: TransactionalId
fields.about: The transactional id, or null if the producer is not transactional.

fields.name: TransactionTimeoutMs
fields.about: The time in ms to wait before aborting idle transactions sent by this producer. This is only relevant if a TransactionalId has been defined.

fields.name: ProducerId
fields.about: The producer id. This is used to disambiguate requests if a transactional id is reused following its expiration.

fields.name: ProducerEpoch
fields.about: The producer's current epoch. This will be checked against the producer epoch on the broker, and the request will return an error if they do not match.

fields.name: Enable2Pc
fields.about: True if the client wants to enable two-phase commit (2PC) protocol for transactions.

fields.name: KeepPreparedTxn
fields.about: True if the client wants to keep the currently ongoing transaction instead of aborting it.
